verdict.rationale: Vue.js is a UI framework, so the evidence covers reactivity, effects and lazy-hydration strategies. These are developer building blocks for wiring event handling in code, not a product capability for defining rules that trigger actions automatically. Nothing in the pack documents a first-party rules or automation engine, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
